# ResponsivePanel { #anylumino.ResponsivePanel }

```python
ResponsivePanel(
    widgets=None,
    *,
    titles=None,
    keys=None,
    breakpoint=760,
    wide_direction='left-to-right',
    narrow_direction='top-to-bottom',
    spacing=8,
    width='100%',
    height=420,
    resizable=True,
)
```

Box layout that switches direction when its width crosses a breakpoint.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type                     | Description                                                            | Default           |
|------------------|--------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| widgets          | iterable or mapping      | Child widgets or keyed child mapping.                                  | `None`            |
| titles           | iterable or mapping      | Optional labels associated with children.                              | `None`            |
| keys             | iterable of str          | Stable child keys for iterable ``widgets``.                            | `None`            |
| breakpoint       | int                      | Width in CSS pixels where the layout switches direction.               | `760`             |
| wide_direction   | str                      | Box direction used when the container is wider than ``breakpoint``.    | `"left-to-right"` |
| narrow_direction | str                      | Box direction used when the container is narrower than ``breakpoint``. | `"top-to-bottom"` |
| spacing          | int                      | Pixel spacing between children.                                        | `8`               |
| width            | int, float, str, or None | Widget width.                                                          | `'100%'`          |
| height           | int, float, str, or None | Widget height.                                                         | `420`             |
| resizable        | bool                     | Whether the panel gets a notebook resize handle.                       | `True`            |
